reddit.title: Explore the New Conquest Campaign in Provincia!
reddit.body: We're excited to share details about our latest update: Tutorial 2 · Conquest! In this campaign, you'll navigate a constrained home basin and five adjacent territories, each with unique rewards and challenges. Check out the full breakdown of territories and their defenders here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin

steam.title: Conquest Campaign Now Available in Provincia!
steam.body: We're thrilled to introduce the Conquest campaign in Provincia! Navigate through a locked home valley and expand your territory by conquering five new regions. Each territory presents unique challenges and rewards. Learn more about this exciting update and how to get started here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/five-territories-beyond-the-basin?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=five-territories-beyond-the-basin
